originalTitle: Grand Theft Auto VI: Pre-Load Now
content: Pre-loading is now available for everyone who has pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto VI digitally. Players who pre-ordered the code-in-box version can also activate their code and begin pre-loading as soon as it’s received. If you still have yet to pre-order, now’s the time to make sure you're prepared for November 19. https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/editions The new single, “Blood In Your Eyes” by Tove Lo, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD at https://gtavi-thealbum.com. Listen to “Blood In Your Eyes” now: https://gtavi-thealbum.lnk.to/bloodinyoureyes

chineseContent: 现在，所有以数字方式预购《侠盗猎车手 VI》的人都可以进行预加载。预购盒装代码版本的玩家还可以在收到代码后立即激活代码并开始预加载。如果您还没有预订，现在是时候确保您为 11 月 19 日做好准备了。 https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/editions Tove Lo 创作的新单曲“Blood In Your Eyes”也可在《侠盗猎车手 VI：专辑》中找到，该专辑的官方原声带目前可在所有主要音乐流媒体服务上预保存，并可在 https://gtavi-thealbum.com 上预订黑胶唱片或 CD。立即收听“你眼中的血”：https://gtavi-thealbum.lnk.to/bloodinyoureyes
